title: Kindergarten Addition and Subtraction Worksheets Within 5
intro: Introduce addition and subtraction within five through actions with objects.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Put out a small collection and act out adding or taking away. Write the equation after the student has described what happened.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

2 + 1 = 3

Two objects, one more object, three objects altogether. The plus sign connects the groups; the equals sign says that both sides describe the same total.

5 − 2 = 3

Start with five, remove two, and count only the three that remain. Put the two back to check that the starting group had five.

Ask your student

How many are here after we make the change?

If your student needs help

If the student focuses only on the new or removed objects, point to the collection that the question asks about.
